.Net and Web Developer 
 Beginner pixel art artist

about.description: I'm a developer with experience in building web applications and software development. My skills include .NET, C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and many other technologies. In my free time, I work on open-source projects and learn new technologies.
about.description2: Currently, I only have the AZ-900 certification, but I’m sure that list will grow soon!
about.description3: When creating pixel art, I try to make small but detailed images. I love experimenting with colors and style. My main drawing themes are flowers and all kinds of plants.
